cases.question: Compare the total FY2023 consolidated revenue of Alpha Corp and Gamma Technologies.

alpha_corp_annual_report_2023.pdf.expected_quote: $125.4 million for FY2023, representing an increase of 14.2% year-over-year.

gamma_technologies_q4_brief.pdf.expected_quote: Gamma Technologies achieved FY2023 consolidated revenue of $125.4 million, matching market consensus.
